subject: Welcome to M'Arte — confirm your email
preview: One last step before we open the doors to M'Arte.
heading: Welcome to M'Arte
message: We are delighted you have joined us. At M'Arte, every detail matters — from the first sketch to the final polish in our workshop.
messageSecondary: Your account will let you track orders with ease, save delivery addresses, and return to your favourite collections whenever you wish.
messageTertiary: Before we begin, we ask one small favour: please confirm your email address. This keeps your account secure and ensures we only send you messages that matter to you.
highlightBody: Once your email is confirmed, your account will be activated. From that moment, you may explore our collections, place orders, and enjoy jewelry crafted with care for every detail.
expiry: For your security, this link will expire in 60 minutes.
ignore: If you did not create an M'Arte account, you may disregard this message — no account will be created.
